A massive debris-laden flash flood struck the Budhi Gandaki River in Gorkha's Chumnubri Rural Municipality after a landslide blocked the river flow. Viral footage captured the shocking moment a giant boulder rolled relentlessly down the grey torrent, highlighting the severe destruction caused by the sudden surge. The flash flood swept away more than 35 houses, several bridges, and local infrastructure across riverside settlements like Jagat and surrounding areas. While authorities have reported no human casualties so far, hundreds of residents have been displaced as rescue teams and security forces mobilize to assess the heavy damage. The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) and local administration have issued urgent high-risk alerts. Residents along the Budhi Gandaki and Trishuli river corridors have been strictly advised to move away from riverbanks and stay on high ground. For immediate emergency assistance or reporting, contact local disaster management or the Nepal Police hotline at 100 or 112. #GorkhaFlood #BudhigandakiFlood #NepalDisaster #FlashFlood #GorkhaNews

A powerful flash flood has swept away the Soti Khola bridge in Nepal’s Gorkha district, as the Budhi Gandaki River surged downstream on Sunday, 11 October. According to Nepalese media reports citing local authorities, the flood destroyed the bridge connecting parts of Aarughat Rural Municipality, along with other bridges and homes. A suspected landslide blocked a stream before water surged downstream, although authorities are still assessing the circumstances and the full extent of the damage.  Emergency teams have been deployed, and residents in vulnerable riverside areas have been warned to move to higher ground. Reports differ on the number of people missing, with at least four reported missing in one update. No deaths had been reported in the latest source checked. #NewsBuzzRAW #Nepal #Floods #BreakingNews #NaturalDisaster
